title.zh: 将南甘马粦省Bula市镇的Inoyonan公立中学的名称正式更名为Felipe P. Panton国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Inoyonan High School in Barangay Inoyonan, Municipality of Bula, Province of Camarines Sur to Felipe P. Panton High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Inoyonan High School in Barangay Inoyonan, Municipality of Bula, Province of Camarines Sur to Felipe P. Panton High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11172_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: - The name of Inoyonan High School in Barangay Inoyonan, Municipality of Bula, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby changed to Felipe P. Panton High School.
- The main campus of the Felipe P. Panton High School shall continue to remain in its location in Barangay Inoyonan, Municipality of Bula, Province of Camarines Sur.
- This act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
